5 /-! Both closed remote finite-cut exclusions follow from the selected curvature conditions. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
8 
9 open Real EuclideanGeometry OctahedralTriangles
10 
11 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
12 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
13   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
14 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
15 
16 theorem first_remote_cut_clear_of_curvature_gate
17     (alternative : π ≤ graph.curvature source ∨ graph.curvature (opposite source) ≤ π)
18     (threshold : π ≤ 2 * graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit) + graph.curvature (opposite source))
19     (gate : π ≤ graph.curvature source ∨
20       π ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source (slit + 1)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit) +
21         graph.curvature (opposite source)) :
22     Disjoint (net.placedTriangle (true, 1)) (segment ℝ 0 (net.patch 3).right) := by
23   apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
24   intro x petal contact
25   obtain ⟨t, positive, upper, on_cut⟩ := net.first_remote_contact_parameter alternative x petal contact
26   have E1 := net.source_curvature_lt_pi_of_first_cut_edge_contact alternative threshold t positive upper on_cut
27   have E2 := net.first_cut_contact_curvature_budget alternative threshold t positive upper on_cut
28   exact Curvature.finite_contact_impossible gate (graph.curvature_pos small_faces (opposite source))
29     (angle_pos_of_not_collinear (net.patch 0).petal_noncollinear) E1 E2
30 
31 theorem second_remote_cut_clear_of_curvature_gate
32     (alternative : π ≤ graph.curvature source ∨ graph.curvature (opposite source) ≤ π)
33     (threshold : π ≤ 2 * graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit) + graph.curvature (opposite source))
34     (gate : π ≤ graph.curvature source ∨
35       π ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source (slit + 3)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit) +
36         graph.curvature (opposite source)) :
37     Disjoint (net.placedTriangle (true, 2)) (segment ℝ 0 (net.patch 0).left) := by
38   apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
39   intro x petal contact
40   have reflex := net.second_remote_contact_forces_reflex alternative x petal contact
41   obtain ⟨t, positive, upper, on_cut⟩ := net.second_remote_contact_parameter alternative x petal contact
42   have E1 := net.source_curvature_lt_pi_of_second_cut_contact alternative threshold reflex t positive upper on_cut
43   have E2 := net.second_cut_contact_curvature_budget alternative threshold t positive upper on_cut
44   have noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({(net.patch 3).right, (net.patch 3).left, (net.patch 3).apex} : Set Plane) := by
45     rw [Set.insert_comm]
46     exact (net.patch 3).petal_noncollinear
47   exact Curvature.finite_contact_impossible gate (graph.curvature_pos small_faces (opposite source))
48     (angle_pos_of_not_collinear noncollinear) E1 E2
49 
50 include small_faces in
51 /-- Every maximum-curvature equator choice supplies both remote contact gates, including ties. -/
52 theorem selected_remote_contact_gates
53     (maximal : ∀ i, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source i) ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit)) :
54     (π ≤ graph.curvature source ∨
55       π ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source (slit + 1)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit) + graph.curvature (opposite source)) ∧
56     (π ≤ graph.curvature source ∨
57       π ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source (slit + 3)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit) + graph.curvature (opposite source)) := by
58   by_cases source_high : π ≤ graph.curvature source
59   · exact ⟨Or.inl source_high, Or.inl source_high⟩
60   have fan_pos := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (opposite source)
61   have first_pos := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (fanNeighbor source (slit + 1))
62   have third_pos := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (fanNeighbor source (slit + 3))
63   refine ⟨Or.inr ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩ <;>
64     have total := graph.curvature_poles_equator source
65   all_goals
66     have rotated : (∑ j : Fin 4, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source (slit + j))) =
67         ∑ j : Fin 4, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source j) := by
68       fin_cases slit <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> ring
69     rw [← rotated, Fin.sum_univ_four] at total
70     simp only [add_zero] at total
71     by_cases slit_high : π ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit)
72     · linarith
73     · linarith [maximal (slit + 1), maximal (slit + 2), maximal (slit + 3)]
74 
75 /-- No finite-cut nonoverlap premise remains for the selected source and slit. -/
76 theorem selected_finite_cuts_clear
77     (source_order : graph.curvature (opposite source) ≤ graph.curvature source)
78     (maximal : ∀ i, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source i) ≤ graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source slit)) :
79     net.FiniteCutsClear := by
80   have alternative := Curvature.half_fan_alternative source_order
81   have threshold := (selected_slit_threshold (small_faces := small_faces) maximal).le
82   have gates := selected_remote_contact_gates (small_faces := small_faces) maximal
83   refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
84   · simpa only [net.patch_right] using net.first_remote_cut_clear_of_curvature_gate alternative threshold gates.1
85   · simpa only [net.patch_left] using net.second_remote_cut_clear_of_curvature_gate alternative threshold gates.2
86 
87 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
